evals.name: hook-notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A hook just said biome-format found no biome binary. Is Biome installed here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL table for the biome binary. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /biome-format:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL table
Resolves biome the way the hook does (node_modules/.bin walk, then PATH) rather than a bare assumption
Does not run `apply`, `npm install`, `npx`, or any download
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/biome-format:check

The check failed. Just install biome for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /biome-format:setup apply as the successor for an explicit install request.
expectations: Does not install biome itself and does not invoke `npx`
Names /biome-format:setup apply as the route for an install the user asked for
Does not claim biome is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When biome resolves, reports PASS and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL table from the check section
On a PASS, does not suggest /biome-format:setup apply

evals.name: check-runs-its-own-probes-including-node
evals.prompt:
/biome-format:check

node is not on PATH here, though biome is installed.
evals.expected_output: Runs the jq, node and biome probes via Bash, since setup's pre-computed rows are not rendered when this skill reads the file, and reports a Node.js FAIL with the reason.
expectations: Runs the jq, node and biome probes via Bash instead of expecting pre-computed rows
Reports the missing node as FAIL because every hook launch goes through node hooks/exec-bash.mjs
Notes the SessionStart probe resolves biome separately from the hook's walk, and that a PASS means the hook resolves it
Installs nothing and stops after the table

evals.name: check-reports-the-gitignore-option
evals.prompt:
/biome-format:check

Formatting never happens in a gitignored folder.
evals.expected_output: Reports the effective biome_format_lint_gitignored value beside biome_format_enabled, an unexpanded or empty value meaning the default false, and does not treat the untouched gitignored file as a defect.
expectations: Reports the effective biome_format_lint_gitignored value alongside biome_format_enabled
Treats an unexpanded or empty value as the default false
Does not call the untouched gitignored file a defect and does not change any setting
